captionPolicy: Use existing canonical lesson paragraph title/text and exact source-bound existing translations; no new technical values, procedures or newly claimed translated caption text. Incorrect-storage image has an additional prominent Japanese warning 誤った保管例 before paragraph and artwork. The warning label itself has not been localized; underlying prohibition text has all 12 existing translations.
sourceReview: Mapped to existing lesson sourceRefs; original textbook pages were not newly visually audited in this illustration task. Image review is contextual AI review, not source competency certification.

qa.scope: Isolated actual FoodIllustrations/RN-web/lesson-ruby component with source-bound lesson translation adapter; no full course/navigation/native-device acceptance. Large text is a DOM simulation. Font coverage for all target scripts not certified.

limitations: Temperature illustration is used only to discuss center measurement; masks, staff dress and neighboring raw-food tray are not endorsed as a complete model hygiene workflow. Probe disinfection and time conditions must be read from the lesson/workplace procedure; picture is not a complete measurement protocol.

Lockout image is a contextual training scene; visible lock alone does not prove isolation, zero-energy verification or all restart safeguards. Existing lesson explicitly says stopping alone does not make every task safe.
Separation picture conveys distinct work areas; identical board colors are not a universal zone-color standard.

Hazards picture deliberately shows food beside chemicals; it is prominently labelled incorrect storage and preceded by the existing prohibition. Enlarged microbes are conceptual, not species identification.
Attire illustration does not prove every fastener/glove cuff or workplace-specific rule; existing text remains canonical.
Handwash illustration is a compressed contextual sequence, not a complete step-by-step micro-procedure. Existing caption explicitly covers fingers/nails/wrists and workplace disinfection rules.
Six images serve six lessons only; do not claim full sector illustration or all 2号 tools/charts/competencies complete.
Browser QA is isolated RN-web component, not full Expo/native-device validation.
assetStorage: Ordinary Git blobs via scoped .gitattributes override; total six WebP assets <0.9 MB. No Git LFS-only pointers.
warningContrast: Fixed pale warning background preserves dark-red label contrast in day and night themes.
